title: competitive-teardown
universal_lens: The competitive teardown codex formalizes a high-dimensional information manifold where active, legally usable data coverage constitutes a sparse submanifold of the seeded source universe. The system enforces a strict epistemic boundary condition: premium user experience must resolve trust, coverage, and conflict metrics within a ten-second temporal window, establishing a rigorous duality between raw data ingestion capacity and instantaneous cognitive comprehension.
gsi_mapping: Galaxy Sports Intelligence maps the 546 seeded sources into a Bayesian hierarchical network, treating licensed route and tracking data as latent variables requiring first-party charting priors. Conformal prediction intervals are applied to the 800 metric definitions, dynamically adjusting confidence scores based on missing data topologies and historical production predictions, ensuring that every exposed statistic carries a quantifiable, mathematically rigorous measure of source trust and freshness.
gse_mapping: Galaxy Sports Engine translates the audit's foundational layers into a discrete state-transition model for situational reasoning. Archetypes and comps function as attractor basins in the tactical phase space, while alerts and versioning act as event-driven triggers. The engine continuously evaluates PFF-like grades and trenches data against the King Standard scorecard, executing real-time updates to the founder cockpit as new discovery queries resolve conflicts in the underlying data graph.

primitives.name: Active Legal Coverage Deficit Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_active: cardinality of legally usable records (dimensionless count); U_seed: cardinality of total seeded universe (dimensionless count).
primitives.assumptions: The seeded source universe represents the theoretical maximum information bound; legal constraints act as a hard filter reducing dimensionality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when C_active approaches zero, rendering the intelligence product statistically vacuous despite high U_seed.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's conformal calibration layer, where the ratio C_active / U_seed dictates the width of uncertainty bands presented to the end-user.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of candidate records successfully mapped to legally cleared, active production tables.

primitives.name: Ten-Second Trust Compression Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_max: maximum allowable cognitive load time = 10s (SI unit: seconds); I_trust: integrated information vector of trust, coverage, and conflict (dimensionless entropy).
primitives.assumptions: Human cognitive processing imposes a strict upper bound on the complexity of metadata that can be simultaneously parsed without degrading UX.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the entropy of the conflict/missing data topology exceeds the bandwidth required to render it within T_max.

layer2.mapping: Drives the GSE 'founder cockpit' visualization hierarchy, forcing complex Bayesian posterior distributions into simplified, high-signal visual primitives.
layer2.telemetry: Average time-to-comprehension for data confidence storytelling modules in A/B testing environments.

primitives.name: King Standard Compliance Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: Audit against the King Standard scorecard and make the interface worthy of the data machine underneath.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_king: scalar compliance score against the ultimate quality benchmark (dimensionless, normalized 0..1); M_data: throughput and fidelity of the underlying data machine (records/sec).
primitives.assumptions: There exists an objective, maximal standard of analytical rigor ('King Standard') against which all derived metrics and UI elements must be evaluated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System degradation occurs if S_king falls below a critical threshold, indicating the UI is oversimplifying or misrepresenting the high-fidelity M_data.

layer2.mapping: Functions as the global loss function for the GSI/GSE alignment layer, penalizing discrepancies between raw backtesting proof and frontend narrative.
layer2.telemetry: Variance between historical production predictions and actual realized outcomes across the 800 metric definitions.

reasoning_traces.think:
The mathematical architecture of the Competitive Teardown Codex revolves around managing the tension between a massive, theoretically complete information universe (U_seed) and the severely constrained, legally permissible operational subspace (C_active). This disparity necessitates a rigorous filtering operator that does not merely discard data but propagates the uncertainty of missing dimensions into the final inference layer. By seeding 546 sources and defining 800 metrics, the system constructs a high-dimensional tensor of potential insights. However, the 'Brutal audit' reveals that the active coverage is a sparse projection of this tensor. To maintain the 'King Standard', the system cannot simply hide these gaps; it must explicitly model them. This leads to the derivation of the Temporal Trust Resolution kernel. If the underlying data manifold is riddled with holes (missing data, unresolved conflicts), presenting raw numbers induces cognitive dissonance. Therefore, the UX must compress the complex topological features of the data—trust scores, freshness decay, conflict resolution paths—into a format digestible within a strict 10-second window. This is not merely a design constraint but a fundamental information-theoretic bottleneck. The GSI mapping handles this by wrapping every metric in conformal prediction intervals, effectively turning point estimates into probability distributions that reflect the epistemic gap. Simultaneously, the GSE mapping treats the 'archetypes' and 'comps' as dynamic attractors in a state-space model. When licensed route or tracking data is missing, the engine relies on first-party charting priors to interpolate the state transitions, ensuring the situational reasoning remains continuous even when the observational stream is fragmented. The entire system acts as a dual-layered filter: one layer expanding the raw data into a rich, probabilistic context (GSI), and the other collapsing that context into actionable, high-confidence tactical states (GSE), all bounded by the unyielding requirement of immediate human comprehensibility.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from classical measurement theory and Bayesian epistemology, specifically the handling of censored data in statistical mechanics. It echoes the development of conformal prediction in modern machine learning, where algorithmic guarantees must hold despite distributional shifts. Historically, it mirrors the evolution of financial risk dashboards, where vast, noisy market feeds must be compressed into instantaneous 'risk appetite' signals for traders operating under severe time pressure, ensuring that the interface never overpromises certainty where only probabilistic bounds exist.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models two distinct opposing agents: the 'Red Team' auditor and the 'Premium User'. The Red Team acts as an adversarial force, constantly probing the boundaries of the seeded universe to expose gaps in legal coverage and logical inconsistencies in metric definitions. Their goal is to minimize the King Standard score by finding edge cases where the data machine fails. Conversely, the Premium User is modeled as a rational actor seeking maximum signal-to-noise ratio under extreme time pressure. They do not want raw data; they want distilled truth. The UX must anticipate the User's skepticism, proactively explaining conflicts and missing data before questions arise, thereby building a psychological contract of trust that neutralizes the Red Team's findings without exposing the User to underlying complexity.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if the GSE's situational reasoning begins to hallucinate states to fill the voids left by the epistemic coverage gap. If the interpolation priors used for missing tracking data become too dominant, the system risks collinearity between inferred archetypes and actual on-field reality. The cross-layer veto mandates that any metric generated by the GSE must be traceable back to a concrete observation in the GSI's conformal bounds. If the uncertainty interval exceeds a predefined threshold (indicating the coverage gap is too wide), the system must trigger a 'data confidence' alert rather than presenting a false sense of precision, effectively blocking the propagation of low-trust signals into the premium UX layer.
